findings.question: q-statistics-and-probability-data-analysis-graphs-0011
findings.quote: This compares Centers A and B but omits C. The larger centers are prominent. Include every center.
findings.problem: This note accompanies 75%, but Centers A and B total 250 on Day 1 and 400 on Day 3. Omitting C gives (400 - 250) / 250 × 100% = 60%, not 75%. The stated mistake does not produce this choice.
findings.fix: Change the distractor from 75% to 60% so it matches the note.
